text: The C++ scaffolding (ros2_common_cpp, docker test script, CI amd64 job, Ansible local-source build at nice 19 without stopping the robot) and the cheap fixes: web_ui lazy serialization and JPEG pass-through, uvc MJPEG pass-through, mcp_server latest-only state cache in Python (web_ui and mcp_server stay Python), plus the per-node CPU before/after measurement.
The two rewrites: stereo_depth_cpp (standalone, background tier) and map_guard_cpp, side by side as _cpp node types with the Python nodes kept present and disabled for rollback.

mcp_server stays a Python node; its measured heavy compute kernels move to the mcp_core_cpp extension (nanobind or pybind11, scikit-build-core, in mcp_server's uv venv): profile first, port only kernels above the stated threshold, golden parity against the Python versions. master2master is not rewritten.
